plain.li: [defended] {PAWN_nameDef} was hurt in the fighting, and {PET_definite} stood its ground and fought for {PAWN_objective}.
[defended] When {PAWN_nameDef} was hit, {PET_definite} planted itself in front of {PAWN_objective} and wouldn't let anyone near.
[defended] {PET_nameDef} put itself between {PAWN_nameDef} and the enemy, and stayed there until the fighting was done.
[defended,small] {PET_nameDef} is not much bigger than a boot, and it went at the raider closing in on {PAWN_nameDef} as if it were a bear.
[defended,big] {PET_nameDef} charged the ones who had {PAWN_nameDef} pinned down, and they scattered.
[fought] In the fighting, {PET_definite} went for the enemy alongside {PAWN_nameDef}.
[fought] {PET_nameDef} fought at {PAWN_nameDef}'s side the whole battle, and came back with blood on its muzzle that wasn't its own.
[fought] {PAWN_nameDef} and {PET_definite} went into the fight together, and came out of it together.
[fought,big] {PET_nameDef} broke the enemy's line before {PAWN_nameDef} could even catch up.
[fought,small] {PET_nameDef} harried the raiders' ankles all through the fight, too quick for any of them to hit.

warm.li: [defended] {PAWN_nameDef} says {PET_nameDef} saved {PAWN_possessive} life today, and has been feeding it the best scraps since.

blunt.li: [fought] {PET_nameDef} bit several raiders, and {PAWN_nameDef} couldn't be prouder.

cheerful.li: [fought] {PAWN_nameDef} is telling anyone who'll listen that {PET_nameDef} won the battle on its own.

cold.li: [fought] {PET_nameDef} engaged the enemy alongside {PAWN_nameDef}, effectively and without orders.

plain.li: {PAWN_nameDef} buried {PET_nameDef} where it used to lie in the sun, and marked the spot with a stone.
{PAWN_nameDef} keeps glancing at the door, as if {PET_nameDef} might still come through it.
[longtime] {PET_nameDef} had been with {PAWN_nameDef} since the early days, longer than most of the people here.
[newpet] {PAWN_nameDef} had only just got to know {PET_nameDef}, and says that makes it worse.
[small] {PAWN_nameDef} dug a small grave for {PET_nameDef}, and was surprised how long it took.
[big] It took three of them to carry {PET_nameDef}, and {PAWN_nameDef} took the heaviest end.
[bonded] {PAWN_nameDef} keeps reaching down to scratch an ear that isn't there.
[master] {PAWN_nameDef} trained {PET_nameDef} from the start, and says {PAWN_pronoun} never once had to raise {PAWN_possessive} voice to it.
[hero] {PET_nameDef} died fighting for the colony, and {PAWN_nameDef} cleaned the blood from its coat before the burial.
[winter] {PAWN_nameDef} kept a fire going by {PET_nameDef}'s grave all night, as if it could still feel cold.

warm.li: {PAWN_nameDef} told {PET_nameDef} it had been a good animal, the best, and stayed until the body was cold.
[longtime] {PAWN_nameDef} wrote down every trick {PET_nameDef} ever knew, so somebody would remember them.

blunt.li: {PAWN_nameDef} dug the grave alone and said nothing to anyone all day.

cheerful.li: {PAWN_nameDef} spent the evening remembering every ridiculous thing {PET_nameDef} ever ate, and had the table laughing by the end.

gloomy.li: {PAWN_nameDef} says everything good out here gets taken eventually, and {PET_nameDef} was very good.

cold.li: {PAWN_nameDef} cleaned {PET_nameDef}'s bowl, put it away, and asked not to be given another animal.

plain.li: I keep hearing {PET_nameDef}'s claws on the floor. It's the wind. It's always the wind now.
Put {PET_nameDef}'s collar on a nail by my bed. I don't know what else to do with it.
[winter] The ground was hard as iron. I dug {PET_nameDef}'s grave anyway. My hands still hurt.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} was the first thing that ever came running when I called. I'll miss that most.

cheerful.li: {PET_nameDef} stole my dinner exactly four hundred times. I counted. I'd give it every dinner I have left.

gloomy.li: Everyone keeps saying "it was just an animal." I've stopped answering.

plain.li: I don't remember much of the fight, except a shape between me and them, and then they were running. It was {PET_nameDef}.
{PET_nameDef} limped a little on the way back and wouldn't let me look at the paw until I'd been seen to first.

warm.li: Sat up late with {PET_nameDef} and told it everything. It listened better than most people do.

blunt.li: {PET_nameDef} saved my neck. I owe it. I always pay what I owe.

cold.li: I underestimated {PET_nameDef}. I won't make that mistake again.

plain.li: [escape,person] {X_nameDef} looked back once from the treeline and raised a hand, as if they'd be seeing each other again.
[escape,person] "Tell {VICTIM} I'll be back," {X_nameDef} shouted, and was gone.
[escape,person,killed] {X_nameDef} laughed as {X_pronoun} ran, and the sound carried all the way back to the colony.
[escape,person,maimed] "Keep the leg warm for me," {X_nameDef} called back over {X_possessive} shoulder.
[escape,beast] It left a trail of blood and trampled brush leading off into the hills.
[escape,beast] Its tracks circle the colony twice before they head off into the wild.
[return,person] {X_nameDef} called out {VICTIM}'s name across the field before the shooting started.
[return,person] {X_nameDef} has been seen at the head of the raiders, pointing at the colony.
[return,person] "Did you miss me?" {X_nameDef} shouted from the treeline.
[return,person,again] Some of the colonists keep a tally of {X_nameDef}'s visits scratched on the storeroom wall.
[return,person,killed] {X_nameDef} shouted that {X_pronoun} had come to finish what {X_pronoun} started.
[return,person,downed] "Still standing, {VICTIM}?" {X_nameDef} shouted. "Not for long."
[return,person,maimed] {X_nameDef} asked, very loudly, how {VICTIM} was getting about these days.
[return,person,robbed] {X_nameDef} shouted that {X_pronoun} had come for {X_possessive} money, and the interest.
[return,person,betrayed] {X_nameDef} called the colony a nest of traitors, loud enough for the whole valley to hear.
[return,person,enslaved] {X_nameDef} rattled a set of chains above {X_possessive} head where everyone could see them.
[return,person,hunts] {X_nameDef} shouted that the hunt was nearly over.
[return,beast] The animals in the pens had been restless since dawn.
[return,beast] There were fresh claw marks on the gate at dawn.
[return,beast,again] The colony knows that howl by now.

blunt.li: [return,person] {X_nameDef} spat in the colony's direction and drew a finger across {X_possessive} throat.

gloomy.li: [return,person] {X_nameDef} didn't shout anything this time, only stood and watched the walls.

plain.li: [loose] Never seen again.
[loose] Gone without a trace, alive or dead.
[loose] Not seen for a long time now. {VICTIM} has stopped looking at the treeline.
[loose] Word on the roads is that {NAME} went somewhere far off, and stayed there.
[captive] Gone from the colony's keeping, and never heard of again.

gloomy.li: [loose] Never seen again, which isn't the same as gone.

plain.li: [recruited] {X_nameDef} is one of the colony's own now, and eats at the same table as the people {X_pronoun} once hurt.
[recruited] {X_nameDef} joined the colony. {VICTIM} hasn't decided yet what to make of that.
[recruited] {X_nameDef} works the same fields as {VICTIM} now. They don't talk much.
[slave] {X_nameDef} wears the colony's collar now, and works for the people {X_pronoun} once hurt.
[beast] Tamed, of all things. {X_nameDef} sleeps in the pen now, and {VICTIM} gives it a wide berth.
[beast] {X_nameDef} eats from the colony's hand now. {VICTIM} still keeps one eye on it.
{X_nameDef}, who {DEED}, is dead.
[person,loose] {X_nameDef}, who {DEED}, is dead. How it happened, the colony never learned.
[person,loose] {X_nameDef}, who {DEED}, died out there somewhere. {VICTIM} heard the news and went very quiet.
[person,captive] {X_nameDef}, who {DEED}, died in the colony's cells.
[beast,loose] The beast that {DEED} is dead. Something bigger got it, or the winter did.
[beast] They found what was left of the beast that {DEED}. It won't be coming back.
[person] The colony let {X_nameDef}, who {DEED}, walk out of the gate. {VICTIM} watched {X_objective} all the way to the treeline.
[person] {X_nameDef}, who {DEED}, has been set free, and the colony will have to live with whatever comes of it.
[person] {X_nameDef} is free. {VICTIM} went back to work without a word.
[beast] The beast that {DEED} has been let go into the wild.
They let {X_nameDef} go today. I stood at the gate and made myself watch.
{X_nameDef} is free. I didn't vote for it. I'm not sure I'd have voted against.

warm.li: They let {X_nameDef} go. I think I'm glad. I don't want to be someone who needs {X_objective} in a cell.

blunt.li: {X_nameDef} walks. If {X_pronoun} comes back, that's on the council.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} is out there again, and I'm in here, and nothing feels finished.

cold.li: {X_nameDef} has been released. I've noted the date.
